units.source_text: Methotrexate is infused over 4 hours after at least 6 hours of prescribed hydration and urine alkalinisation. Folinic acid rescue starts 24 hours after the methotrexate infusion starts, usually every 6 hours initially, and is adjusted to timed levels and kidney function. Cisplatin runs over 4 hours with its own fluid prescription. Doxorubicin may be given by intravenous push or a separately prescribed 48-hour central-line infusion.

units.source_text: Cisplatin has high nausea/vomiting risk; doxorubicin and high-dose methotrexate have moderate risk. Each visit needs its own reconciled anti-sickness prescription. Methotrexate hydration, alkalinisation, level monitoring and folinic acid rescue must continue until the specialist team confirms safe clearance. Delayed clearance may need intensified rescue or glucarpidase. No fixed discharge day is promised. Low blood counts or a delay to the next chemotherapy dose must not automatically withhold or stop folinic acid rescue for methotrexate already given.

units.source_text: Confirm complete removal of all visible tumour, nonmetastatic eligibility and recovery from surgery. Calcineurin inhibitors such as ciclosporin and high-dose nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory painkillers must not be combined with mifamurtide. Check with oncology or the pharmacist before taking, starting, changing or stopping any medicine, including over-the-counter products; do not stop prescribed medicines yourself. Routine or chronic corticosteroids should be avoided, but emergency use is a separate medical decision. Any premedication requires an individual prescription, especially for a child. Arrange the separate 36-week treatment record.

units.source_text: A specialist team prepares and gives a one-hour intravenous infusion; it must not be given as a rapid bolus. Treatment preparation uses the supplied filter; that is distinct from an administration-line filter.

Preventive inhaler treatment may be considered for asthma or chronic obstructive lung disease.

units.source_text: The five 24-hour ifosfamide infusions total 120 hours at the full reference schedule.
